entries.title: Ezekiel 37:1
segments: ¶The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which [was] full of bones,

words.text: was upon me, and carried me out

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:2
segments: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, [there were] very many in the open valley; and, lo, [they were] very dry. {valley: or, champaign}

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:3
segments: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:4
segments: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:5
segments: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

words.text: into you, and ye shall live

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:6
segments: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.

words.text: upon you, and will bring up
in you, and ye shall live

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:7
segments: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:8
segments: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but [there was] no breath in them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:9
segments: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live. {wind: or, breath}

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:10
segments: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:11
segments: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:12
segments: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

words.text: , and cause you to come up

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:13
segments: And ye shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:14
segments: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken [it], and performed [it], saith the LORD.

words.text: in you, and ye shall live

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:15
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:16
segments: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and [for] all the house of Israel his companions:

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:17
segments: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:18
segments: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou [meanest] by these?

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:19
segments: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which [is] in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, [even] with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

words.text: them with him, [even] with the stick

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:20
segments: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:21
segments: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:22
segments: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

words.text: to them all: and they shall be

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:23
segments: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

words.text: themselves any more with their idols
, nor with any of their transgressions
them out of all their dwellingplaces
them: so shall they be my people
, and I will be their God

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:24
segments: And David my servant [shall be] king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

words.text: over them; and they all shall have one

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:25
segments: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, [even] they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David [shall be] their prince for ever.

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:26
segments: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

words.text: with them; it shall be an everlasting
with them: and I will place

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:27
segments: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

words.text: also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God
, and they shall be my people

entries.title: Ezekiel 37:28
segments: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
